label: How a proxy gets gamed
subgoals: Find outputs that score well and ignore it
Recognize hacks that silence the checker

label: Predicting the hack
subgoals: List what the policy can change that the reward does not see

label: Defenses
subgoals: Pair each proxy with a check of what it ignores
Stop when proxy reward rises while accurate scores stall
